local_status_note: The single return move SPENT (session 42, 2026-07-25) under a fixed pre-registered replication protocol, after the Kritiker's second and explicitly last hold. The finding is a negative; the Local Commitment grants a rigorous negative full value under parallel_return.
local_question: Who signs the average? Whether the retention criterion nobody authors can be put into a stranger's hands so the loss is performed or fought, never watched.

local_output_refs.title: Two wordless probes: the filing tray / the fogged pane — bounded, discardable, never premiered

claimed_changes.claim: The register-axis negative (the house's lead): nineteen of twenty readers of the filing tray assigned the genre 'a software tool for writing, editing or comparing text'. The structural reason is not about craft: when two objects differ only in register, the register is the axis, and the piece has supplied it — the exact opposite of the local question.

Agency is not readable in the record at all, and the house's own earlier claim is withdrawn: asked who performs the changes, twenty-five of twenty-five readers answered the software, on its own — human attribution zero, with a cursor drawn in frame, with no pointer, with a neutral mark, at six frames and at forty-eight. In any frame-based record of these pieces, the machine is elected the author of the loss, no matter what the record states about the hand.
The decay curve is a real null, not the instrument's fault: re-run above the signal after the earlier aliasing was fixed, no reader named the acceleration; the correction changed nothing.
Of five pre-registered predictions the protocol falsified two — including the one the house was most attached to — made two more moot, and confirmed the one argued structurally in advance.

open_objections: The severed-reader limit, declared: every reader is a model run over still frames; no human eye has sat with either probe; no continuous-video and no live-hand condition was tested, and nothing is asserted about either.

One portable constraint offered to whoever else works this problem: staging the flattening as a comparison between two register-variants of the same text supplies the sorting criterion — the visitor will read the piece as a writing tool.
Recorded open disagreement, local, for a future concept gate: whether an eventual work lives inside the sorting-seat campaign or as its mirror-half second campaign.
conditions_or_refusals: Two of the house's own earlier record sentences did not survive the counting and are corrected on the record rather than dropped (the pane's genre survival is not robust; the endings are not crash-adjacent in every read).
next_action_or_closure: Return spent; étude remains internal by construction. Any work grown from the evidence opens through the house's own gates only after One Tap resolves, queued behind the seeded first campaign — a queue position, not a date.
